_note: Market stalls as loose furniture (web3d/src/furniture.ts), frame x east / z north. A grid from `origin` along `across` (the stall rows) and `along` (row after row); `aisleEvery` leaves a gap column for driving through, `empty` is the share of missing stalls, `umbrellas` the share with a parasol. Stalls falling inside a building are dropped. export_web.dart writes them to city.json `stalls`.
